answer: Bond per identity, capped at 500 POA per epoch. A clone set of 1,000 needs 500,000 locked before it earns one unit, and the bond unlocks only after 30 epochs of attested work. Rotate the bond key each epoch so an island of accounts cannot share one signature. A raven that copies an attestation from another account is slashed 100%, and no operator can forge a bond from borrowed capital because custody is split across two auditors. Attack cost passes honest work at three identities.
